cases.name: Linda Dewey
cases.about: In the family statement, Dewey was described as a wife, mother, grandmother and sister with a large extended family all over the world. “She was loved deeply and loved her family deeply,” the statement says. “She was the heart of our family.”
cases.narrative: On 3/4/2026, her body was reportedly found in a dried up creek bed. He allegedly shot Margaret Oldroyd in the head as she sat down to watch TV in her home in Lyman, UT, then took her Buick but realized he didn't like the car. He drove to a nearby trail, where he encountered Natalie Graves and her aunt Linda Dewey and shot them, the documents allege. He allegedly stabbed Dewey when she continued to move. He abandoned the Buick, and took a Subaru that belonged to Dewey or Graves. The husbands of Dewey and Graves later found their bodies near a trail head and called authorities, according to the Utah Department of Public Safety.
